title: Memoir '44 Sim scenario
description: A scenario for the m44-sim app: the map editor's maps and the catalog's files (src/data/catalog/<id>.json). Positions are { row, col } on the 13 × 9 board seen from the Allies' side (row 0 is the Axis' back row; odd rows have 12 hexes). The app checks the rules too (parseScenario in scenarioFile.ts): no unit on water, one unit per hex, and so on.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this format; the app ignores it

board.description: "standard": the standard board, 13 hexes across and 9 rows. Or a bigger board grown in the map editor: hexes in a long row (odd rows have one fewer) and rows, always odd

id.description: Lower-case words joined by hyphens; saves and the catalog find the scenario by it, and a catalog file is named after it

description.description: A few sentences shown in the menu

notes.description: Where the scenario comes from and the rulings made for it; not shown in the app

initialHandSize.description: No longer used: the old card game's command cards each side started with. Older files still have it, and the app drops it

attacker.description: The side that fires first in the battle; the defender's units start with 1 ammo or shell less

tiles.description: The hexes of each terrain; a hex not listed is plains

units.description: Where each side's units start, by unit type

reinforcements.description: No longer used: the Reinforcements card's old table of a unit per die face (the card now always brings infantry). Older files still have it, and the app drops it

paradrop.description: Units one side drops on the table before the game starts; that side's app asks where they landed

wire.description: Hexes with barbed wire (not on water)

sandbags.description: Hexes whose unit starts with sandbags (either side's)

elite.description: Hexes whose unit starts as elite (either side's)

pickedTiles.description: The painted tiles picked for some hexes (towns) in the map editor: each tile is a file's name, without .webp, in its terrain's folder of the tile library (scripts/board-art/tiles/town/). The other hexes' tiles are picked by the hex

extraDraws.description: No longer used: the old card game's extra draws. Older files still have it, and the app drops it

bigGuns.description: Sides that get Cortina de Fuego (Barrage); both when left out

airPower.description: Copies of each air card per side: one per air sortie, 0 against the enemy's air superiority; 1 each when left out

cardCosts.description: The actions mode: a lower cost for some command cards, per side, by card id (finest-hour, resupply, refuel, air-bombardment, reinforcements, barrage, air-power); a card left out costs what the card says

fordableRivers.description: Its rivers can be forded (house rule): a unit wades in and stops, can still fire with a die less, and is fired at as in the open

victory.description: How the scenario is won in pass and play: the first side to this many medals at the end of a turn. Each enemy unit destroyed is a medal; each objective hex is a medal for its side while one of its units stands on it at the end of a turn

hexes.description: Each hex is a medal (not on water)

cardCosts.description: A card's id and its cost to the side, a whole number 0 or more

localized.description: A text in each language; an empty one shows the other

row.description: Up to 8 on the standard board, one fewer than the board's rows

col.description: Up to 12 on the standard board (11 on odd rows), one fewer than the board's columns
